0022600094.text: The Charlotte Hornets (1-0) host the Atlanta Hawks (1-0) in their second game of the season, with Charlotte sitting 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East and Atlanta 1st in the Southeast and 2nd in the East. Charlotte will be without Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar and Mouhamed Gueye. The 2025-26 season series went to the Hornets 3-1, with no games played yet in 2026-27, and Charlotte won the last meeting 110-107 in Charlotte on February 11, 2026.
